label: App Marketplace
seo_description: Discover apps and blueprints that extend RunMyCampus—activate per campus with governed scopes and sandbox review.
headline: App marketplace.
subheadline: Extend your platform with approved apps, ready-made setups, and integrations—activate per campus so local policy stays local.

segments.title: Activate per campus
segments.body: Enable extensions campus by campus—permissions, fees, and workflows follow each school’s configuration, not a one-size HQ mandate.

segments.title: Integrations
segments.body: LMS, payments, messaging, and data exchange with versioning and kill switches scoped to the campuses that need them.

segments.title: Governed rollout
segments.body: Review pipeline, permission scopes, and sandbox so only safe extensions reach the tenants you choose.

faqs.question: How are marketplace apps reviewed?
faqs.answer: Extensions go through a governed review path with permission scopes and operational safeguards before you activate them on a campus.

faqs.question: Can we enable an app on one campus only?
faqs.answer: Yes—marketplace activation is per campus. Groups keep shared governance without forcing the same app mix everywhere.

faqs.question: Can we build our own pack?
faqs.answer: Yes—use the developer platform and packaging flows documented for partners and internal builders.
